name: 2C-G-N
summary: 2C-G-N, or 2C-G-NPH, also known as 1,4-dimethoxynaphthyl-2-ethylamine, is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine, 2C, and naphthylethylamine families. It is the derivative of 2C-G in which the 3,4-dimethyl groups have been extended and connected to form a second benzene ring and hence has a 2-naphthalene ring system.
